title: Race manager
sort.label: Sort
cmp.hint: Tick two finished races to overlay them
cmp.sub: B − A: a negative time or pace = B was faster (green)
cmp.note: One point every 0.5 % of the distance. Point-by-point on the same route, each kilometre and the pace uphill / downhill are on the full comparison:
cmp.same_course: Both races ran the same route ({name}); the full comparison lines them up point by point.
none: No races yet: press Add a race, or mark an activity as a race on its page.
source.manual: You marked it a race on the activity page
source.title: The title says it was a race
col.name: Name
del_confirm: Delete “{name}”? It goes from the season plan too, with its GPX.
day.upcoming: Once raced and matched to an activity, the day's pace, heart rate, power and climbing show here.
est.sub: A positive gap = slower than estimated
est.none_pred: No estimate to compare: fill in the estimated time, or save a calculation in the race calculator.
est.none_actual: No activity matched yet, so no actual time.
splits.sub: the time of each kilometre as a pace
no_dist: This activity has no distance data to split
ed.name: Name
ed.pack_tip: The pack on a hiking trip (day 1 of a multi-day one); blank = the default pack: the single-day / multi-day default pack under Settings › Advanced › auto-estimated parameters when you set one, else the median of your own recorded packs once you have 3 trips of that kind (single-day / multi-day), else 4 kg for one day, 9 kg for several (estimated). The hiking prediction uses it, and so does the loaded steep power hiking before the trip
gpx.up_tip: Upload this race's .gpx / .fit course; once stored, the race calculator and the course-constant reference lines use it
ed.need: Fill in the name and the date
cairn.import_how: Paste the share link of a Cairn trip: its route and day ends become this race's GPX (replacing the one stored), and the race takes the route's distance, climb and days; the date stays.
cairn.import_pick_na: Once Cairn is linked, pick one of your own trips from the list; a trip someone shared with you comes in by its share link.
cairn.unavailable: Pushing to Cairn needs you signed in and your Cairn account linked under Settings › Links; this site doesn't offer it right now.
cairn.no_google: Pushing to Cairn needs a linked Cairn account, and accounts that sign in with email can't be linked yet. Sign in with Google to use it.
cairn.link_first: Cairn isn't linked yet: link your Cairn account in Settings first to push.
cairn.plan: Pushing to Cairn comes with a paid plan.
cairn.what: What goes: this race's GPX, the race calculator's saved pace curve and the overnight points.
cairn.not_ready: Upload a GPX and save a calculation in the race calculator first.
cairn.what_origin: What goes: the race calculator's saved pace curve and the overnight points.
cairn.origin: This race's GPX was imported from the Cairn trip "{name}": pushing updates that trip instead of making a new one; its route file, its name, and the points and times you added in Cairn stay as they are.
cairn.done_origin: The original trip updated in Cairn
cairn.new_go: Make a new trip in Cairn
cairn.imported_ev: Imported {name}: this race is now {km} km, +{gain} m, {days} {days|day|days}
grp.ask: This is the timetable my club / group planned: check whether I can keep up
grp.sub: The Cairn trip has {n} {n|time|times} over {days} {days|day|days}. Ticked, the race calculator compares the group's pace with yours leg by leg (Keeping up with the group).
grp.tip: Only reads the times in Cairn; nothing is changed there. The first guess: {why}
grp.tip_none: Only reads the times in Cairn; nothing is changed there.
grp.sig_marked: this route is marked "a group's timetable" in Cairn
grp.sig_user: {u} of {n} {n|time|times} were typed in by someone, like a group's itinerary
grp.sig_estimate: {e} of {n} {n|time|times} are Cairn's own pace estimates, not like a group's plan
grp.sig_recruit: this route is recruiting a group in Cairn
grp.sig_legacy: this route is older than Cairn's record of who wrote each time, so it isn't ticked by itself
grp.saved_on: Set as the group's timetable: the race calculator will compare you with it
cairn.from_new: Brought from Cairn: “{name}” ({days} {days|day|days}). Check the date, type and priority, then press “Save”: the route is imported into this race and the race calculator opens.
cairn.from_fail: The link brought from Cairn could not be read: {msg}
ct.pick: Pick one of your Cairn trips
ct.empty: No trips in your Cairn yet
ct.card_body: Import straight from your Cairn trips, no link to paste; sync again in one tap when you change one.
